name: Pierce County, WA
findings: Pierce County has 2,423 nonprofit organizations. 1,072 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 892 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pierce County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 104 education organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 46 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 104 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list public events
observations.text: 11 economic development organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 25 would.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 167 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 167 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
